environment.description: Same Jenkins CI/CD pipeline deployed in isolated build environment. Service connectivity is established through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with private DNS disabled. Route tables for the build subnet (rtb-0f9e8d7c6b5a4) contain only local VPC CIDR (10.200.0.0/16) and pl-63a5400a (S3 gateway prefix list) entries — no NAT gateway, no internet gateway attachment exists on the VPC. DNS resolution within the VPC is handled by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint (rslvr-in-a1b2c3d4e5f6) configured with forwarding rules that resolve only *.internal.corp and AWS service endpoints. The EC2 instance metadata service is configured with HttpEndpoint=enabled, HttpTokens=required, HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1. The plugin's strictMode remains false. Network ACL nacl-0abc123def456 on the build subnet has explicit DENY on egress to 169.254.169.254/32 (rule 50) and ALLOW only to 10.200.0.0/16 and pl-63a5400a on egress (rules 100-110), with default deny-all (rule *).

config.network: isolated subnet, no IGW/NAT, route table rtb-0f9e8d7c6b5a4 with local + S3 gateway prefix list only
config.nacl: nacl-0abc123def456: egress DENY 169.254.169.254/32 (rule 50), ALLOW 10.200.0.0/16 + pl-63a5400a (rules 100-110), default deny-all
config.dns: Route 53 Resolver rslvr-in-a1b2c3d4e5f6, forwarding only *.internal.corp and AWS service endpoints
config.access: service accessible only via VPC endpoint from authorized VPCs
